 "data": "classDiagram
direction LR

class Customer {
 +int customer_id
 +str first_name
 +str last_name
 +str national_id
}

class Currency {
 +str code
 +str name
 +str symbol
}

class ExchangeRate {
 +int exchange_rate_id
 +str currency_code_from
 +str currency_code_to
 +float rate
 +str effective_at
}

class Transaction {
 +int transaction_id
 +int customer_id
 +int exchange_rate_id
 +str currency_code_from
 +str currency_code_to
 +float amount_from
 +float amount_to
 +float rate_used
 +str date_time
}

Customer \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Transaction : makes
ExchangeRate \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Transaction : used by
Currency \"1\" --> \"0..*\" ExchangeRate : source currency
Currency \"1\" --> \"0..*\" ExchangeRate : target currency
",
 "config": null

class ConsoleApplication {
 -MoneyExchangeSystem system
 +run() None
 -exchange() None
 -show_all() None
 -add_customer() None
 -add_currency() None
 -add_rate() None
}

class MoneyExchangeSystem {
 -MoneyExchangeDatabase database
 -str DATE_FORMAT
 +close() None
 +add_customer(first_name, last_name, national_id) Customer
 +remove_customer(customer_id) None
 +list_customers() list~Customer~
 +add_currency(code, name, symbol) Currency
 +remove_currency(code) None
 +list_currencies() list~Currency~
 +add_exchange_rate(code_from, code_to, rate, effective_at) ExchangeRate
 +remove_exchange_rate(exchange_rate_id) None
 +list_exchange_rates() list~ExchangeRate~
 +exchange(customer_id, code_from, code_to, amount) Transaction
 +remove_transaction(transaction_id) None
 +list_transactions() list~Transaction~
}

class MoneyExchangeDatabase {
 -sqlite3.Connection connection
 +close() None
 +add_customer(...) Customer
 +remove_customer(customer_id) None
 +list_customers() list~Customer~
 +customer_exists(customer_id) bool
 +add_currency(...) Currency
 +remove_currency(code) None
 +list_currencies() list~Currency~
 +currency_exists(code) bool
 +add_exchange_rate(...) ExchangeRate
 +remove_exchange_rate(exchange_rate_id) None
 +list_exchange_rates() list~ExchangeRate~
 +find_latest_exchange_rate(code_from, code_to) ExchangeRate
 +add_transaction(...) Transaction
 +remove_transaction(transaction_id) None
 +list_transactions() list~Transaction~
 -create_tables() None
 -delete_by_id(...) None
}
